name: Leonardo
source:
Leo (the lion head), the self proclaimed Eldest Brother, was always the straight forward one. Almost to the point of childlike simplicity. Always says what he thinks but doesn't always think about what he says.

[From [url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=27411]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
